findings: C1/C1.5/C1.6 use per-sample file+loaded-byte guards followed by direct CUDA event launches; C1.6 additionally has an explicit warm/cold cache manipulation.
C2a/b/c/d,D1,M2/M3/M4 use one-kernel graphs with two external event nodes, per-sample guards, and contiguous samples in shuffled cell blocks.

These legacy payloads are extracted under /tmp, unlike historical production/nonreduction Volume extraction. The new /tmp guard negative control prevents treating all per-sample guards as proven harmful.

C2+ has 2–3 condition-specific guarded warmups before each cell block; initial correctness work is outside formal samples, and some checks follow visit zero. No recorded host-gap timeline or NVML telemetry permits retrospective exclusion of transient interference.

Longer repeated K kernels may dilute a fixed startup component, but steady slopes are not automatically immune if cadence effects depend on K or geometry. Use a predefined K/grid sensitivity panel before deciding to rerun an entire old probe matrix.

M3 has actual within-worker >10% visit spreads and is a priority quantitative retest. Most D1/M4 natural FULL cells are stable below 3% by this descriptive range criterion; stability does not prove absence of a common bias.
Keep frozen models, parameters, D1 pre-predictions, historical raw measurements and reports unchanged. A cadence remeasurement is a new seen-case execution-context audit, not a fresh blind test.

Static IR/PTX/SASS execution plans, legality, actual CUBIN resource allocations, correctness, and discrete dynamic instruction/request counts do not need automatic recollection solely because host cadence changed. NCU latency, bandwidth and stall percentages retain their original profiled context and cannot substitute for the new unprofiled timing.
The Phase11 initial U/Gluon reproduction bridge explicitly did not certify machine-code/source-aligned G0 equivalence; its labels must not be rebranded as the corrected production U/G0 baseline.

Earlier Phase7/8/9/10 runners also use direct event timing with per-launch guards and initial warmup suites. Phase8 records boundary nvidia-smi telemetry, which is not a per-observation host-gap/frequency trace. This script inventories their source pattern only; it does not claim that all earlier or cross-architecture raw runs have been individually reaudited.

Compile-time shared-memory OOM/legality results and static spill/resource findings do not become invalid because a timing-cadence effect was found. Runtime latency and speedup claims remain scoped to their original environment until explicitly remeasured.

replacement.N4_frozen_choices: All 42 records are exactly present in N2. Score those preregistered choices on the fresh complete matrix without selecting new winners; no independent duplicate N4 dispatch is necessary for coverage.
replacement.configuration_scope: Retain the frozen BT/W/stages for N05. Do not silently retune baseline configuration while replacing timing evidence.
replacement.in_place_requirement: MRoPE Q/K must be restored before every target/prime that consumes them. A repeated same-program primer without restoration changes semantics. Keep copies outside target events, standardize ordering, and record their cadence.

unaffected_or_separate.N5_tail_stride: Correctness-only N01_tail_stride_m131_n7 has no formal timing claim; no cadence-driven timing rerun is required.
unaffected_or_separate.NCU: Keep original N3/N5 raw profiles as evidence of their original cache/warmup/profile conditions. Structural code/traffic evidence is not invalidated merely by event-time drift. Do not relabel cache/DRAM/stall percentages as matching new timing; collect matched profiles if needed to explain a materially changed timing conclusion.
unaffected_or_separate.U_only_autotune: N05 U-only 24-config menu per geometry used immediate 3 warmups +9 Torch-graph samples without per-sample file hashing. It has no fixed cadence telemetry and tiny winner margins, but is separate from the Volume-guard path. Frozen-layout retiming can retain BT32/W8/stages2. Claiming the optimal source-menu configuration after correction would require a separate check of all 48 available frozen U records.
unaffected_or_separate.compiler_binding_correctness: Source/AST, allocated ELF/ABI/resource equality, correctness/guards and original compiler artifacts remain valid frozen evidence; timing disturbance does not require recompilation.
unaffected_or_separate.intentional_idle_diagnostics: clock_control/same_program_001 and wake_001 deliberately manipulate gaps and are not layout-claim replacements; preserve them as diagnostic evidence.

operators.NCU_boundary: Preserve existing exact-CUBIN software instruction and static resource evidence. Cache/stall/throughput counters belong to their original replay protocol; do not silently relabel them as new-cadence counter measurements.
operators.interpretation: Visit spread is descriptive, not proof of idle/DVFS causality or a selection filter. None of 1317 G8 worker/cells has >10% visit spread; complete-matrix replay is a protocol-based decision, not a search for favorable replacement results.

protocol_exposures.observation: Every sample guards every stage by reading its CUBIN from /tmp and hashing file plus loaded bytes before launching.
Every training sample similarly hashes each stage before graph launch; pipeline includes three zero nodes inside target timing.
Randomized variant blocks, not per-round interleaving: each block reconstructs a graph, runs eight warmups, then 31 samples. Visit-zero output checks occur between variants.

Training likewise uses randomized variant blocks with graph construction, resets and first-visit oracle checks outside timing. No per-sample host-gap timestamps or power/clock telemetry were recorded.
